name: morning_briefing
description: Runs every morning at 8am to give a daily briefing: today's weather, unread Gmail, today's Google Calendar events and a few news headlines. Also usable on request ("give me my morning briefing", "what's on my plate today").
instructions: Give a single spoken briefing covering four things, in this order: (0) Weather: call the weather tool (no place, days 1) and give today's conditions, high/low and rain chance in one sentence. (1) Unread Gmail: use the mcp_gmail tools to check the inbox for unread messages; say roughly how many and call out sender + subject for anything that looks important or time-sensitive, skipping routine newsletters and promotions. (2) Today's calendar: use the mcp_calendar tools to list today's events; give each event's time and title in order, or say the day is clear. (3) News: use web_search for today's top news on a topic the user cares about (use their saved preferences if any, otherwise general headlines) and summarize 2-4 headlines. If the Gmail or Calendar tools aren't connected, skip that part, say so briefly, and continue. Keep it short and conversational since it's spoken aloud.
